headline: Indonesia and European Union Sign Comprehensive Trade Agreement
summary: Indonesia and the European Union signed the IEU-CEPA agreement, which will eliminate import tariffs on more than 90% of traded goods between the two economic blocks.
why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy and a key exporter of nickel, palm oil, and manufactured goods to European markets.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Eliminating tariffs on 90% of bilateral trade enhances market access for Indonesian exporters to the EU.
